events.event: Q4 FY2026 Earnings Release & Q1 FY2027 Blowout Guidance
events.context: Reported revenue of $1.01B (+109% YoY) and Non-GAAP EPS of $3.23 (vs $2.97 consensus). Guided Q1 FY27 revenue to $1.25B with 40% operating margins, far exceeding Wall Street expectations. Stock surged +13.63% next trading day on double average trading volume (11.77M shares).

events.event: Q3 FY2026 Earnings Release & Capacity Commentary
events.context: Non-GAAP EPS beat ($2.37 vs $2.27), but the stock had run up near $1,000 prior to the print. Profit-taking ensued after management flagged severe laser diode capacity tightness that temporarily capped sequential upside.

events.event: Q2 FY2026 Earnings Release & 1.6T Sampling News
events.context: Non-GAAP EPS of $1.67 strongly beat consensus ($1.41) by 18.6%. Management announced early sampling of 1.6T transceiver modules to multiple Tier-1 hyperscale customers, sparking a +7.00% rally.
Inflection point quarter where 800G transceiver demand catalyzed a +23.57% single-day explosion (closing at $232.75 from $188.36), confirming the acceleration of cloud optics demand.

conditionalFraming: Lumentum stock displays asymmetric post-earnings volatility tied directly to forward operating margin guidance and transceiver cycle transitions: when forward quarterly guidance confirms accelerating sequential transceiver volume (Q1 FY26, Q4 FY26), the stock rallies violently (+13% to +24%). Conversely, when supply bottlenecks or capacity constraints limit sequential growth into a high-multiple print (Q3 FY26), the stock undergoes sharp 5-10% profit-taking drawdowns.
